Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Swiggy's One BLCK upgrade header - the metallic "one BLCK" logo draws itself stroke by stroke over a dark plum benefits page, then a gold shimmer sweeps across the tagline pill "EXCLUSIVE BENEFITS, JUST FOR YOU".

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Dark plum screen with back chevron: a large metallic chrome "one BLCK" wordmark with a crown flourish, a gold tagline pill "EXCLUSIVE BENEFITS, JUST FOR YOU", a "BENEFITS AT A GLANCE" divider, an "All Swiggy One benefits" icon row, benefit cards (On-Time Guarantee, Free Express Delivery), and a pale "Upgrade Now at ₹299" button.

## Motion spec
Pattern: logo draw with shimmer sweep, ~1.6s.
- Draw: the wordmark strokes on with a path-drawing effect, metallic gradient filling as each letter completes (900ms total, letters left to right with 60ms overlap); the crown flourish draws last (+150ms).
- Tagline: the gold pill fades in (250ms) after the draw, then a bright shimmer band sweeps left to right across it (500ms, ease-in-out).
- Benefits: the icon row and cards fade up 12px (300ms, 50ms stagger) after the shimmer passes.
- Idle: a soft shimmer re-sweeps the logo every 4s.

## Calibration
- The logo fill is chrome/silver - the shimmer is the only gold accent besides the pill.
- The upgrade button and cards are present from the start, dimmed at 60% until the logo finishes.

## Reduced motion
Logo and pill fade in together (400ms); no shimmer.

## Don't miss
- Letters draw, not fade - each stroke is visible as it forms.
- The tagline pill's shimmer is a single band pass, not a gradient cycle.
